title: 코스피8000·삼성전자 SK하이닉스 AI HBM 슈퍼사이클 PER6과 시장유동성 지금 살 이유 vs 기다릴 이유
core_message: 61분 2026 May KOSPI 8000 및 반도체 이익시황 대담. 삼성1Q 영업이익57.2조·SK 37.6조, 05-11/13 시총 삼성1660·SK 1400조대는 실제 기업IR/거래소 보도와 근사 일치. 선행PER6~7 vs TSMC24, 연간 영업이익345/250조는 차트/애널리스트 예상치로 기준일 확인 미완료. 시장 자금수요 700/130/200조는 총액이 곧 주식유입/하락방어 보장이 아니다. 지금 살 이유(이익/밸류/머니무브/참여자 변화)와 기다릴 이유(시장 사이클/행동편향/손실고통/미래 불확실성)를 모두 제시, 특정 투자 정답 없다고 끝맺는다.
limitations: Source 1877 private user original 71-100.zip SRT cues, 144775 bytes, ending 01:01:09.039, SHA exact preflight registered.
2026-05-15 KOSPI first 8000 intraday event not necessarily close of 8000; 1980 base100 ratio not actual index fund return.
May Samsung/SK capitalization rough figures match contemporaneous dates; specific screen figures P/E 6-7 versus TSMC24 not independently time matched.
Samsung Apr30 official consolidated 1Q57.2, SK Apr23 official 1Q37.6 are historical results; future full 2026 profit forecasts of345 and250 trillion are not actual results.
TSMC Q1 30trillion KRW converted with currency/operating profit original official IR not matched.

2026 banking checking700trillion, investor deposit130trillion, short term cash >200trillion screens not reconciled with BOK/KOFIA official time series; double-count and no implied equity-flow constraints.
2021-22 cycle examples and 2000 stock anecdotes detailed brokerage records and fund adjusted historical transaction prices unverified.
Speaker explicitly offered both bullish and wait scenarios, no guaranteed 'buy Samsung now' directive.
Original soundtrack, slides, independent full public ASR exact comparison NOT_TESTED. Private original ZIP/SRT never copied to public GitHub.
